item.text: {"analysis":"The trial failed before training: the host reported invalid_source with invalid syntax at line 194 and allocated_gpu_seconds=0.0. The submitted source still contains unresolved ======= merge separators, duplicated forward methods, and malformed check_exported_predictor definitions. No validation score was produced, so model quality and R-Drop effectiveness remain unmeasured. Repair requires retaining one bidirectional forward method and one complete export-check function, removing conflict fragments and the undefined _attention_mask path, and keeping training and predictor architecture consistent.","code_summary":"Intended architecture: one independently trained masked Transformer per category, with 96-dimensional item and position embeddings, two bidirectional pre-normalized Transformer blocks, two attention heads, dropout 0.2, a GELU output projection, tied item scoring embeddings, and jointly trained item biases. Training uses masked histories with a mandatory final query mask, 256 shared sampled negatives, two dropout passes, averaged cross-entropy, and symmetric KL regularization weighted 0.1. Final-position loss receives half the weight when auxiliary masks exist. Each category selects one checkpoint by local validation HR@10 with NDCG tie-breaking; the exported predictor routes to exactly that category's single model. No ensemble is intended."}
